added: Decal.wet multiplies the receiver's diffuse albedo and covers its normal-map detail by opacity, using a flat normal when the decal has no map. Authored roughness also reaches screen-space reflections, so puddles can form flat mirrors. The default false retains the existing colour mix and additive normal bend.

breaking.change: The reflected record adds wet, default false.
breaking.fix: Re-cook scenes against the updated schema; leave wet false to retain existing decals.
